project_type: .sct: Electron desktop app (electron-vite) with a React renderer, a CLI (`sct run`), an SDK in packages/env, and a SpacetimeDB relay module in packages/relay
test_framework: Bun test running node:test files in tests/*.test.ts (`bun run test` runs `cd tests && bun test projects.test.ts vault.test.ts runtime.test.ts sharing.test.ts envelope.test.ts`); Playwright Electron tests in tests/*.spec.ts with playwright.config.ts at the repository root (testDir ./tests, testMatch *.spec.ts, workers 1). Specs launch `electron.launch({ args: [join(__dirname, 'electron-entry.cjs'), userData] })`, which loads out/main/index.js, so `bun run build` must run first.
build_command: bun run build (runs typecheck:tsc, build:sdk, electron-vite build, build:demo, build:airdrop)
test_command: bun run test; Playwright: from tests/ run `bunx playwright test --config ../playwright.config.ts <spec>` after `bun run build`
verification_instructions: From the repository root: bun run check (eslint --max-warnings 0 plus bun check type checks), bun run test, bun run typecheck:tsc, bun run build, bun run react-doctor (react-doctor --scope full --blocking error). Then from tests/: `bunx playwright test --config ../playwright.config.ts platform.spec.ts` (Windows smoke test) and `bunx playwright test --config ../playwright.config.ts theme.spec.ts` (theme restart test). Never run tsc directly.
snapshot_or_generated_files: docs/media/themes/cream/{unlock,projects,sharing,storage}.png are 1200x800 Windows screenshots of the Cream variant. Regenerate them with a throwaway Playwright Electron script placed in the OS temp folder (not in the repository), after `bun run build`, using a temp userData with settings.json { vaultRoot } and preferences.json absent (Cream is the default). out/ and packages/env/dist are build outputs and are not part of the change.
setup_instructions: Dependencies are installed (node_modules exists). If needed: bun install from the repository root.
environment_constraints: Windows host, PowerShell. Shared checkout on branch main with many uncommitted user changes and untracked files. Another agent task (task-c8d-transport-receipt) edits src/main/sharing.ts, src/main/index.ts, and src/shared/transport.ts in this same checkout at the same time, so a check failure in those files may come from that work, not from this task. Do NOT commit. Do NOT revert or reformat unrelated changes. Do not edit AGENTS.md, docs/fork-plan.md, or docs/implementation-plan.md. Several runtime tests skip on win32 (POSIX only). The UI tests use tests/electron-entry.cjs, which turns the relay off.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: ASD-STE100 style for docs and comments; TypeScript only; no `any`; no tests unless approved (only the two approved tests); inline values that are used once; colors and fonts only through CSS role tokens; Cream: dark forest green accent, cream text on green fills, black ink otherwise; square 1px rules, no shadows; no new hues; run react-doctor before UI work is finished; Playwright check after a UI change; never run tsc directly.
key_patterns: styles.css: `:root` holds Terminal token values; `:root[data-theme="cream"]` replaces token values only. Accent role tokens: --color-accent (fill), --color-accent-ink (text on fill), --color-accent-text, --color-accent-line, --color-accent-edge, --color-focus, --color-hover-ink. Current Cream block sets --color-accent oklch(46.1% 0.121 145) and --color-accent-ink var(--color-paper-2), but does not override --color-accent-text, --color-accent-line, or --color-focus, so Cream links, status text, focus rings, and lines are green now. The header link uses `.header-start nav a[aria-current="page"]::after` (2px accent bar below). The sharing tab uses `.sharing-tabs a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--color-accent); border-top-color: var(--color-accent) }` (green text). Inputs: `input { border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-2) }` and the select rule `.sharing-section select, .panel select, .relay-inbox select, .import-dialog select, .appearance select { border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-2) }`. Theme preference: src/main/preferences.ts writes userData/preferences.json; src/main/index.ts loadTheme sets nativeTheme.themeSource and passes --sct-theme; renderer main.tsx sets data-theme on <html>. Storage > Appearance has <select id="theme-select"> labelled Theme (light/dark/system). CLI: src/main/launch.ts requireRunArguments(args) is not exported.
directory_structure: src/main: Electron main process and CLI (launch.ts, preferences.ts, index.ts). src/preload: bridge. src/renderer/src: React views and styles.css. src/shared: shared types (api.ts). tests: node:test unit tests (*.test.ts) and Playwright specs (*.spec.ts). docs: design and decision docs (theme.md; decision tables in docs/fork-plan.md and docs/implementation-plan.md must not change).
